info.scen_description: Make a best-selling board game in this radically different scenario that has nothing to do with disease! Investors have given you two years to design, produce and distribute your very own game - but can you make it a best selling hit? *Insert witty subliminal marketing about Plague Inc: The Board Game here* :P
info.scen_link_title: About Plague Inc: The Board Game
info.scen_init_popup1_title: Welcome to the Ultimate Board Games scenario
info.scen_init_popup1_text: Investors have given you TWO YEARS to design, produce and distribute a new board game. Can you top the sales charts in that time?
info.scen_init_popup2_text: Once you've built the IKEA office furniture and grabbed yourself a coffee, you can immediately get started on designing your game.

educational.name: Educational
educational.description: Teach all kinds of pursuits, even the trivial ones. Slightly increases hype and complexity.

movies_tv_radio.name: Movies/TV
movies_tv_radio.description: Tap into the popular culture vein. Slightly increases hype and complexity.

sports.name: Sports
sports.description: Football? Racing? Rugby. Build a mini theatre of dreams for a table top. Slightly increases hype and lowers complexity.

adult.name: Adult
adult.description: Appropriate for 18+ audiences only. Slightly increases hype and lowers complexity.

strategy.name: Strategy
strategy.description: The ideal game for those that like to take risks. Slightly increases hype and significantly increases complexity.

murder_mystery.name: Murder/Mystery
murder_mystery.description: Wannabe detectives and killers alike will want to take a stab at this. Increases hype and complexity.

horror.name: Horror
horror.description: An evening of blood, guts and eldritch entertainment will ensue with this theme attached. Increases hype and complexity.

party.name: Party
party.description: Get any party started. Increases hype and lowers complexity.

medical.name: Medical
medical.description: Save/wipe out humanity (delete as appropriate). Increases hype and complexity.

select_themes.name: Select Themes
select_themes.description: Action this to access board game themes.

humour.name: Humour
humour.description: Perfect for splitting sides. Increases hype and complexity.

war_game.name: War Game
war_game.description: Resolve disagreements in a reasonably non-violent manner. Increases hype and complexity.

animals.name: Animals
animals.description: Domesticated or untamed: take your pick. Increases hype and complexity.

economic.name: Economic
economic.description: Accrue pretend wealth. Maniacal laughing optional. Increases hype and complexity.

nautical.name: Nautical
nautical.description: Both masters and commanders will enjoy sinking ships. Increases hype and complexity.

family.name: Family
family.description: Inspire evenings of forced 'fun'. Increases hype and significantly lowers complexity.

cooperative_play.name: Co-Operative Play
cooperative_play.description: Just get along. Slightly increases hype and significantly increases complexity.

hand_management.name: Hand Management
hand_management.description: Think tactically about what you're holding to win. Slightly increases hype and significantly increases complexity.

player_elimination.name: Player Elimination
player_elimination.description: Players can be removed and have to sit watching everyone else have fun. Slightly increases hype and significantly increases complexity.

select_mechanics.name: Select Mechanics
select_mechanics.description: Action this to access board game mechanics.

area_control.name: Area Control
area_control.description: Make a game of territory taking and trespasser trapping. Slightly increases hype and significantly increases complexity.

trading.name: Trading
trading.description: Strike deals. Sticking to them optional. Slightly increases hype and complexity.

bluffing.name: Bluffing
bluffing.description: How's your poker face? Increases hype and complexity.

take_that.name: Take That
take_that.description: It's ok to sabotage, obstruct and hold grudges in this game. Increases hype and complexity.

dice_rolling.name: Dice Rolling
dice_rolling.description: Make a game with luck-based dice rolls (BGG frequenters won't be fans). Increases hype and complexity.

competitive_play.name: Competitive Play
competitive_play.description: Inspire faceoffs (not the Nicolas Cage kind). Increases hype and complexity.

memory.name: Memory
memory.description: Make a game of remembering things and feeling your age. Increases hype and complexity.

press_your_luck.name: Press Your Luck
press_your_luck.description: Unleash your inner gambler. Just one more go... Increases hype and complexity.

timers.name: Timers
timers.description: Make a game in which players must hurry, after all, a good game is a quick game. Increases hype and complexity.

cards.name: Cards
cards.description: Make a game involving decks of cards. Slightly increases hype and significantly increases complexity.

tokens.name: Tokens
tokens.description: Make a game involving playable tokens. Slightly increases hype and significantly increases complexity.

dice.name: Dice
dice.description: Make a game involving ivory chance cubes. AKA. dice. Increases hype and complexity.

select_components.name: Select Components
select_components.description: Action this to access board game components.

miniatures.name: Miniatures
miniatures.description: Painting them is optional - doing little voices as you move them around, not so. Increases hype and greatly increases complexity.

select_player_number.name: Select Player Number
select_player_number.description: Action this to increase the number of players for your board game.

single_player.name: Single Player
single_player.description: It's complicated to balance, but a solo mode allows people to play every night of the week! Increases hype and complexity.

two_players.name: Two Players
two_players.description: Two's company! Increases hype and complexity.

three_players.name: Three Players
three_players.description: Three is a crowd (but a happy one). Increases hype and complexity.

four_plus_players.name: Four + Players
four_plus_players.description: Four (or more) is a party! Increases hype and complexity.

announce_game.name: Announce Game
announce_game.description: End the Design phase of your board game project and begin actually making it! Unlocks Production options.

manufacture_in_china.name: Manufacture in China
manufacture_in_china.description: Manufacture your board game so you can sell them. Reduced costs but higher chance of quality issues.

manufacture_in_usa.name: Manufacture in USA
manufacture_in_usa.description: Manufacture your board game so you can sell them. Expensive but lower chance of quality issues. Increases hype in the USA.

manufacture_in_germany.name: Manufacture in Germany
manufacture_in_germany.description: Manufacture your board game so you can sell them. Expensive but lower chance of quality issues. Increases hype in Germany.

launch_kickstarter.name: Launch Kickstarter
launch_kickstarter.description: Crowdfunding campaign provides funds and increases hype. Especially effective for complex board games.

extended_backer_program.name: Extended backer program
extended_backer_program.description: Allows more backers to help fund your board game after the initial Kickstarter campaign has completed. Increases hype and funds.

community_outreach.name: Community Outreach
community_outreach.description: Ensure your Kickstarter backers are kept informed of the project's progress. Increases hype.

community_feedback.name: Community feedback
community_feedback.description: Ask your Kickstarter backers for feedback on elements of your game, such as the rulebook wording and box layout. Increases hype.

toy_line_ip.name: Toy Line IP
toy_line_ip.description: Negotiate for the license of a famous toy brand. Significantly increases hype, especially for board games with family friendly themes.

videogame_ip.name: Videogame IP
videogame_ip.description: Negotiate for the license of a famous videogame. Significantly increases hype, especially for board games with strategic themes.

film_tv_show_ip.name: Film/TV show IP
film_tv_show_ip.description: Negotiate for the license of a famous movie or TV show. Significantly increases hype, especially for board games with movie or TV related themes.

advertise_online.name: Advertise Online
advertise_online.description: Purchase targeted ad space online. Increases hype.

advertise_in_stores.name: Advertise In Stores
advertise_in_stores.description: Purchase storefront ad space at FLGSs (Friendly Local Game Stores!) worldwide. Slightly increases hype.

advertise_at_conventions.name: Advertise At Conventions
advertise_at_conventions.description: Purchase a booth at GenCon and others. Increases hype.

how_to_play_videos.name: How To Play Videos
how_to_play_videos.description: Record and publish a series of tutorial videos. Slightly increases hype.

official_website.name: Official Website
official_website.description: Set up a dedicated website with forums for your game. Increases hype.

early_review_copies.name: Early Review Copies
early_review_copies.description: Send out early review copies to board game focused media publications. Increases hype.

begin_manufacturing.name: Begin Manufacturing
begin_manufacturing.description: Have the factory start building the components and boxing up your board game. Unlocks the 'Distribution' screen.

view_samples.name: View Samples
view_samples.description: Have your manufacturer send you samples of your game components - just in case there are any last minute quality issues!

conduct_test_sessions.name: Conduct Test Sessions
conduct_test_sessions.description: Invite board game fans to a test session and gather feedback - just in case you need to make last minute tweaks!

begin_distribution.name: Begin To Sell Your Game
begin_distribution.description: Once your board game is designed and produced, it's time to start getting it into players' hands! Unlocks Distribution options.

companion_app.name: Companion App
companion_app.description: Release a companion app for your board game on smartphones. Significantly increases hype.

direct_sales.name: Direct Sales
direct_sales.description: Who needs retailers? You can sell your game yourself for much cheaper! Increases availability.

local_game_stores.name: Local Game Stores
local_game_stores.description: Work with smaller, FLGSs to get your board game on their store shelves. Slightly increases availability.

national_retailers.name: National Retailers
national_retailers.description: Work with selected national retailers to ensure they stock your game. Increases availability.

international_distributors.name: International Distributors
international_distributors.description: Work with international distributors to get your board game on as many store shelves globally as possible. Significantly increases availability.

sell_on_amazon.name: Sell On Amazon
sell_on_amazon.description: Sell your board game on the far-reaching eCommerce site. Significantly increases availability.

sell_on_bgg.name: Sell On BGG
sell_on_bgg.description: Sell your game on the Board Game Geek website to make sure core board gamers can find your game. Increases availability.

sell_on_ebay.name: Sell on eBay
sell_on_ebay.description: Casual players might like your game too! Make sure they can find it on eBay. Increases availability.

super_fan_sendout_1.name: Super Fan Sendout 1
super_fan_sendout_1.description: Super fans can help spread the word about your board game. Increases hype and availability.

super_fan_sendout_2.name: Super Fan Sendout 2
super_fan_sendout_2.description: Identify YouTubers who might like and play your game and send them copies to show off to their viewers in videos. Increases hype and availability.

super_fan_sendout_3.name: Super Fan Sendout 3
super_fan_sendout_3.description: Negotiate a brand deal with a prominent influencer to get your game in front of millions of viewers. Increases hype and availability.

localise_language_1.name: Localise Language 1
localise_language_1.description: Work with translators to produce versions of your board game in other languages. Increases availability.

localise_language_2.name: Localise Language 2
localise_language_2.description: Produce further translated versions of your board game. Increases availability.

localise_multiple_languages.name: Localise Multiple Languages
localise_multiple_languages.description: Hire on-site translators to produce many more translated versions of your board game. Significantly increases availability.

sales_promotions_1.name: Sales promotions 1
sales_promotions_1.description: Take a financial hit in order to increase availability in poor countries.

sales_promotions_2.name: Sales promotions 2
sales_promotions_2.description: Take a larger financial hit in order to significantly increase availability in poor countries.

durable_packaging_1.name: Durable Packaging 1
durable_packaging_1.description: Make sure your board game can ship reliably to distant destinations. Increases availability.

durable_packaging_2.name: Durable Packaging 2
durable_packaging_2.description: Make sure your board game can ship without issues to distant destinations. Greatly increases availability.

additional_production_run_1.name: Additional Production Run 1
additional_production_run_1.description: Make sure your stock levels can keep up with demand! Increases availability.

additional_production_run_2.name: Additional Production Run 2
additional_production_run_2.description: The more stock you get out there, the more people will be able to find your game. Significantly increases availability.
